metadata.batch: Batch D51 (follow-live viewport for the LWC main chart)
metadata.note: P11: D51 follow-live viewport (AC-D51.1-AC-D51.5). Waves P11-W1 (T1 follow-state definition + repro probes) -> P11-W2 (T2 no-yank live path, then T3 Fit/reset + affordance) -> P11-W3 (T4 per-symbol memory, then T5 same/new replacement) -> P11-W4 (T6 batch gate). Repro-first every wave; no skips/xfails; no new module, no migration, no order-code touch, Qt-free boundary held.

tasks.title: Follow-state definition + repro probes (D51.1; S-P11-1)
tasks.description: Add a page-side derived isFollowing() to chart_assets/lwc/chart.js (following iff the newest bar's logical slot is inside getVisibleLogicalRange()), expose offscreen-queryable follow-state and visible-range probes, and land repro-first tests proving the current tree has no follow surface and refits unconditionally.
acceptance_criteria: Given a loaded main chart at the live edge and a chart scrolled back by scripted pan/zoom, when the follow-state probe is queried offscreen, then the former reports following (newest bar's slot inside the visible range) and the latter reports scrolled back.

Given a seeded series offscreen, when the visible-range probe is queried, then it reports the newest bar's logical slot and the current visible logical range consistently with the library timeScale, so later waves can assert viewport identity without re-deriving geometry.

tests.description: Seeded-series offscreen probe: chart at live edge reports following; scripted pan/zoom away reports scrolled back; keyboard/wheel-driven pan also reports scrolled back (AR-P11-1). Red pre-fix (no isFollowing surface), green post-fix.
tests.expected_result: Fails pre-fix (probe surface absent); passes post-fix with edge/scrolled-back distinguished.

tests.description: Visible-range probe returns newest-slot + visible logical range matching the library getVisibleLogicalRange for a seeded series; plus a static assertion that pre-fix applyOps refits unconditionally (documents the yank as the repro baseline).
tests.expected_result: Probe assertions pass post-fix; the unconditional-refit characterization holds on the pre-fix tree.

tasks.title: No-yank live path (D51.2; S-P11-2)
tasks.description: Gate every viewport movement on the live update path on isFollowing(): remove the unconditional post-applyOps fitToWidth, leave the visible range untouched on update_bar upserts while scrolled back, follow only when isFollowing(), and resume on user pan-back-to-edge via scrollToRealTime/setVisibleLogicalRange with no automatic resume on new bars.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scrolled-back viewport, when live bars arrive offscreen, then the visible logical range is bit-identical before and after and follow stays disengaged.
Given a scrolled-back viewport, when the user pans back to the edge, then follow resumes via the realtime scroll; new bars alone never re-engage follow.

tests.description: Seeded series scrolled back offscreen; inject update_bar upserts (new periods + forming-bar ticks); assert visible-range slot identity across every injection and follow still disengaged. Red pre-fix (unconditional refit moves the viewport), green post-fix.
tests.expected_result: Fails pre-fix (range moves on upsert); passes post-fix with range bit-identical.

tests.description: While away, inject new bars and assert follow stays disengaged (no auto-resume); then script pan-back-to-edge and assert follow re-engaged through the realtime scroll path.
tests.expected_result: No auto-resume on bars alone; follow re-engages only on pan-back-to-edge.

tasks.title: Fit/reset + go-to-realtime affordance (D51.3; S-P11-4)
tasks.description: Make Fit/reset frame all loaded bars and re-engage follow via the existing fitToWidth framer, and add a go-to-realtime affordance that appears exactly when away with new-bars-since-away and invokes the realtime scroll on activation.
acceptance_criteria: Given any viewport state, when Fit/reset is invoked offscreen, then the viewport frames all loaded bars and follow is re-engaged.

Given a scrolled-back viewport, when new bars arrive while away, then the go-to-realtime affordance appears, and invoking it scrolls to realtime and re-engages follow; with no new bars while away, or while following, the affordance stays hidden.

tests.description: Seeded series in scrolled-back and following states; invoke Fit/reset offscreen; assert range frames all loaded bars and follow reports engaged in both cases.
tests.expected_result: Fit frames all bars and re-engages follow from any starting state.

tests.description: Scrolled back + injected new bars shows the affordance; invoking it scrolls to realtime and re-engages follow; following state and away-without-new-bars keep it hidden (both show/hide transitions asserted, AR-P11-4).
tests.expected_result: Affordance visibility is exactly (away AND new-bars-since-away); invocation re-engages follow.

tasks.title: Per-symbol viewport memory (D51.4; S-P11-5)
tasks.description: Add an in-memory Python-side symbol-to-{range, following} store on the LWC view fed by throttled page range reports (gesture-end + post-update only); save on switch-away via the existing set_symbol lifecycle and restore on switch-back via a range op, with no persistence and no schema change.
acceptance_criteria: Given symbols switched offscreen and back, when the follow/scroll state is queried, then the restored symbol shows its remembered viewport range and follow state.
Given the per-symbol store, when inspected, then it is in-memory session state keyed by upper-cased symbol with no persistence and no schema change (a fresh view starts empty).

tests.description: Offscreen view: load symbol A, scroll back, switch to B, switch back to A; assert A's remembered range + follow state restored exactly (freshest gesture-end/post-update report wins, AR-P11-2).
tests.expected_result: Switch-back restores the remembered viewport + follow state for each symbol.

tests.description: Store keyed by upper-cased symbol (lowercase set_symbol lands on the upper-cased key); fresh view holds no entries; bars/drawings/alarms schemas and migrations untouched.
tests.expected_result: Upper-case keying holds; no persistence and no migration exist.

contracts.signature: LwcView._viewport_memory: dict[str, dict] // upper-cased symbol -> {range: {from, to}, following: bool}; in-memory only, saved on switch-away, restored on switch-back

tasks.title: Same/new full-series replacement (D51.5; S-P11-3)
tasks.description: Carry a same-vs-new continuity directive on full-series replaces: same symbol re-applies the preserved viewport range and follow state after the replace (no visible jump while scrolled back), new symbol starts following the live edge; zero-bar Fit stays a no-op with no error.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scrolled-back viewport, when a full-series replacement for the same symbol lands offscreen, then viewport range and follow state are preserved (slot-identical, no jump).

Given a full-series replacement for a new symbol, when it lands offscreen, then the chart starts following the live edge; and given a zero-bar series, when Fit is invoked, then it is a no-op with no error.

tests.description: Scrolled-back seeded chart; same-symbol full replace (backfill-shaped); assert range slot identity and follow state preserved across the replace (AR-P11-3).
tests.expected_result: Same-symbol replace preserves viewport + follow with no jump.

tests.description: New-symbol full replace starts following the live edge; zero-bar series Fit is a no-op with no error (Journey 44 edge).
tests.expected_result: New symbol follows; zero-bar Fit neither errors nor moves.

read-only: fitToWidth framer the new-symbol path reuses

contracts.signature: full-replace continuity: {same_symbol: bool} // same symbol re-applies preserved {range, following}; new symbol fits to the live edge

acceptance_criteria: Given all P11 tasks done, when the five AC checks (follow query, no-yank, Fit/affordance, per-symbol restore, same/new replacement) are re-run, then every one is green.

Given the P11 production diff, when reviewed, then it touches only the viewport path (chart.js viewport gating + view update wiring) with pop-out/data/order paths untouched, no skipped or xfailed tests added, and the full offscreen suite green.

tests.expected_result: All five AC suites and the JS tests pass.
